headline: Need Hardware
subline: Ready-to-use hardware from our backers and partners.
_order: Optional. A preferred left-to-right arrangement, chosen so heights and colours alternate rather than clumping. Devices named here are placed first in this sequence; anything in devices.json that isn't named is appended after them, and a name that has left devices.json is skipped. Deleting this key falls back to devices.json order.
_scales: Optional. Which devices appear always comes from devices.json — nothing here needs editing to add or remove one. These are relative size nudges for artwork that would otherwise read wrong next to its neighbours: a physically large device gets a number above 1, a small one below. Anything not listed renders at 1. A name that is no longer in devices.json is reported and ignored.
